description.text: Champion's League 2005 was held at TFT Hall in Tokyo on 18 September 2005 for the first-place winners of Battle Road Summer 2005 in each age division and the previous year's Elite Four. After a Swiss qualifying round, the top four of each division became the new Elite Four and played for the grand champion's title; each won the cosmos holo Stadium card Champion's League in a trophy shield. Side events let spectators play, including a Challenge PCL corner against the game's developers.
